notes: Continue on a thread whose row holds a display slug (fable-5.1) no longer fails with "issue with the selected model (fable-5.1[1m])". v180 fixed only the composer send; Continue and every other respawn (session.continue -> continueRun, refreshAccount -> dropHandle -> handleFor) read the model from the stored row, and two rows still held fable-5.1 verbatim because resolveModel (shared/catalog.ts) kept an unknown model as asked. resolveModel now maps a bare display slug to its catalog id (lowercase, dots to dashes, exact `<provider>-<slug>` match, so gpt-5.5 and cursor ids cannot mis-hit; a nonsense string still stays verbatim, never the default). openDb (db.ts) repairs every non-archived row through the same normalization at boot and logs one line per row, so the two poisoned threads heal on the next launch. handleFor (sessions.ts) normalizes the stored model before driver.start, so a poisoned row cannot reach `--model` even before that boot. Tests: catalog.test.ts (slug mapping, pass-through, foreign id, nonsense), db-model-repair.test.ts (a stored fable-5.1 row reads back as claude-fable-5-1; archived rows untouched), sessions-model-repair.test.ts (a respawn from a poisoned row hands the driver the catalog id).
